notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hey Pong Fans! Yesterday we released an update for PONG Quest with the following changes:

[list]
[*] XP Tracker in the Quest Journal now shows the correct number instead of zero.
[*] Fixed a bug where pausing was not working when inside a challenge vortex.
[*] 2560 x 1440 screen resolution now supported in the options menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where elements may be cut off on some monitors with a "bleed" zone.
[*] Other minor stability fixes.
[/list]

Thanks for all your feedback so far, we're glad so many of you are enjoying the game.

Keep Paddlin'!
